## Findings refused

- Unit 1 i "had been in tears" (past perfect): ažuγ̇u 有來 is a plain past; kept, acceptable after kürbe.
- Unit 31 i drops the genitive of eke-jin ("Mother Sotan's gift"): sense and force are unchanged, note already explains.
- Unit 23 Ming 迭 ("in turn") against "escorting": mismatch is already confessed in n and morph; no better reading available from the Ming alone.
- Unit 39 baγ̇ulžu "take a wife in": already flagged as a guess; kept.
- Unit 46/51/63 bracketed (i) in köġün(i)-jen, emeġel(i)-jen, morid(i)-jan: could be accusative (Ming 行) or linking vowel; the draft treats it as Shiratori's, as does the published §87 part for deġü-ner(i)-jen; no change beyond keeping the note.
- Unit 35 "Tula": modern name for Tuγ̇ula; plain spelling, kept.
- Unit 67 Boγ̇orču glossed 女名行 by Ming: draft's slip theory is hedged; kept as is.
- Unit 5 "to me" supplied: flagged in n; kept.
- Unit 48 "you" (Temüjin addressed) removed; unit 49 "gave you" kept: n already says 'to you' is supplied.
- Unit 2 tense (present mu rendered as past): normal narrative; kept.

# Review, pass 2 — secret-history-093-099 (§§93–99)

Backups: scratchpad `units.json.p2.bak`, `gloss.json.p2.bak`. `t` and word counts untouched (71 units, 444 words). Units numbered from 0. Every morph Ming bracket was compared with the packet word by word (all 444 agree); every gloss.json key equals a novel-forms token (no missing, no extra) and ends in the novel-forms Ming gloss; the three `__broaden__` entries are each the known-forms entry whole + ' · ' + the new clause. Grammar labels of all suffix morphs in units.json were scanned (back/front-vowel forms, -ču/-čü, -gsen, -dür/-dur): no further faults.

## Findings refused

- Unit 28 morph qoṅγor "bay or dun, yellowish-brown": copies the shared glossary entry (qoṅγor-i) word for word; unit text already says dun. Kept for consistency.
- Unit 46 n "köġün(i)-jen … with the accusative" against the morph's "bracketed i is Shiratori's": pass 1 already refused; unchanged.
- Unit 22 i "to Temüjin … with him": supplied by context and by the Ming 相配; n says the English follows the Ming.
- Unit 51 i "your saddle": whose saddle is ambiguous; pass 1 chose, note states the shift.
- gloss `mönö`, `kiġed`, `žalγamsiγtan`, `sonostamu`: analyses are hedged ("inferred", "uncertain") and tied to the Ming; no better reading from the Ming alone.
- Unit 30 n "büleġe at the next unit boundary": a plausible but unproved link between two clauses; left as a hedged statement.
- Unit 48 "Onan" against the shared glossary's "Onon": the unit keeps Shiratori's form in `l` and `n`; not a pass-2 fault.

Counts: major 0, moderate 3, minor 12, trivial 6 (21 changes); refusals 7.
